author: puffballstudios
title: Artist call for Abida comic Issue #2
content: 📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢 Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2 We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: ○ Finishing and refining line art / inks ○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages ○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches ○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework. You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels. If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: ctfdn_official
title: Horror illustrators wanted - paid opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.) Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them! #ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities
